messages: Maya Li: Heads-up — noticed a broken anchor jump on staging for runtime/kv-caching. Clicking the 'delta-keys' link lands at top of page. Production looks fine. Anyone own runtime/kv-caching? jamie: Repro. Anchor is missing in the generated HTML. @docs-bot, who last touched that file? docs-bot: Edit history: /docs/runtime/kv-caching.md updated by @Victor Reyes (PR #4021) — header slug simplified to 'kv-keys' Victor Reyes: That's me. I simplified the slug to be consistent with our header conventions; missed updating a handful of internal references. I'll push a micro-PR to restore the old anchor as an HTML fallback. jamie: Restoring a fallback anchor is fine for now, but can we add a CI check to catch fragment mismatches? Tiny test would save follow-ups. Nora Chen: I can add a smoke test in the docs CI that scans markdown for links with "#" and verifies targets exist after build. Worst-case we fail the docs preview. Victor Reyes: Opening PR #4066 — adds a hidden above the header and a short comment noting the canonical id is 'kv-keys'. Also updated the two in-repo calls I found. Maya Li: Can someone trigger a staging preview for #4066? I don't have the preview token for that site. jamie: Kicking the preview through the deploy bot now. docs-bot: Preview build started for PR #4066 — https://staging-preview.example.com/preview/4066 Maya Li: Preview looks good, anchor jump now lands on the right section. jamie: Quick review done, small nit in the PR description but not blocking. :thumbsup: Victor Reyes: Merged and backported the anchor to release branch. Filing docs-ops ticket DOCS-589 to add the fragment existence smoke test; Nora if you pick it up I can help. Nora Chen: I'll take DOCS-589, adding it to the sprint board. Maya Li: Thanks everyone for the quick turn. Closing thread — ping me if anything else pops after the backport.
